_meta.about: Home v2 only: merged by engine-v2/api.js AFTER the shared engine-v2/data/v2.json (data-overlay on the api.js tag; overlay wins, objects merge, arrays replace). Paths in srcset and nextup_media are relative to THIS file (the engine resolves them here); nowbar_media paths are page-relative (only page.js reads them). Passes, payload, timetable capacities, coach lines and the reviews come from the shared engine overlay (one copy).
